tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sngags rgod lok+t+ri'i rgyun khyer snying po drang srong dmod pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ṛ ṣi kro dha rā dzā ya/'dir dra
༄༅/ /sngags rgod lok+t+ri'i rgyun khyer snying po drang srong dmod pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ṛ ṣi kro dha rā dzā ya/'dir dra

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags rgod lok+t+ri'i rgyun khyer snying po drang srong dmod pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ṛ ṣi kro dha rā dzā ya/

'dir drang srong zhe sdang rdo rje'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i dmigs gnad snying por dril te nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gsal btab la/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas sogs kyis tshogs bsags nas thog mar zhi bar bsnyen pa ni/ āḥ rang lus tha mal dhu ti'i nang*/ /snying thad pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /nyi zla'i gdan la āḥdakar po/ /de las 'od 'phros sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /rtsa gsum 'dus mdor pad+ma ni/ /dmar mo 'dab ma bzhi steng du/ /āḥyig ri bong 'dzin pa'i mdog /'od 'phros lus gang nad gdon sbyangs gang na sar nyi steng āḥdakar gyis sbyang ba bya/ mchan/ skad cig bdag nyid drang srong ni/ /sku mdog sngo skya skem rid gzugs/ /smin ma ag tshom rgya mdor slebs/ /ras dkar smad dkris stod g.yogs can/ /pad zla'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin spyi blugs dang*/ /g.yon pas phreng ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /'khor du drang srong 'bum gyis bskor/ /gdod nas dam ye gnyis su med/ /snying gar nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /srog gi snying po hūm̐ mthing nag /trang du'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ /oṃ trang du tri na trang du dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas drag por sgrub pa ni/ drang srong zhi ba 'od zhu nas/ /rang gi lus kyi ngo bo ste/ /mthing nag gnam lcags rdo rje ni/ gnas pa rtsa la shes par bya zhes pa'i don no/ rtse dgu che brjid rno dbal 'bar/ /yar rtse me 'bar tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /mar rtse byad ma gan rkyal gyi/ /lce yis brang kheb snying dbus gzer/ /rdo rje'i lte ba yangs pa'i nang*/ /gser gyi tsakra rtsibs brgyad dbus/ /rang nyid skad cig khro bo ni/ /zhe sdang rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /dang po gnyis kyis tho ba dang*/ /ral gri 'bar ba rab tu gdengs/ /mtha' gnyis gnam lcags phyag mthil la/

/ser mo lcags sdig mgo dgu 'phyar/ /kham nag dbu skra gyen du brdzes/ /nyi zla'i gdan la brkyang bskum bgrad/ /shin tu khro zhing mi sdug pa/ /rgyan med me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /spyi bor drang srong dri med dang*/ skabs 'dir drang srong gi phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs rnon bsnams pa'o/ /de steng rigs bdag pad 'byung bzhugs/ gsang 'dus yab yum/ /thugs kar hrīḥlas 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad dbus su pad nyi'i steng*/ /ye shes sems dpa' gsang ba'i bdag /mthing nag sbrul rgyan stag shams can/ rgyud kyi dgongs par mthun/ /rdo rje rtse lnga dril bu bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis phyed skyil tshul gyis bzhugs/ /thugs srog mchong gur phub 'dra ba/ /zur brgyad dbus su nyi ma'i steng*/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ mthing nag /shin tu gsal zhing 'tsher bar bsgom/ man ngag sems la shes par bya zhes pa'i don no/ /dbyings nas ye shes spyan drangs thim/ /mchod bstod bya ba'am ma byas kyang rung ste bzlas pa ni/ /lce rtsar āḥlas zla dkyil la/ /āḥyig dkar po trang dus bskor/ /de dbus lce ni gnam lcags kyi/ /rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte ba ru/ /nyi steng hūm̐ la sngags phreng bskor/ 'dren pa dkyil du shes par bya zhes pa'i don no/ /rtse yi rwa dgu phyir gdangs shing*/ /khong sing bcas pa'i rtse mo ru/ /phaṭa dmar mchong bcag lta bu dgur/ gcod pa rtse la shes par bya zhes pa'i don no/ /me yi tshwa tshwa drag tu 'phro/ /lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /sde brgyad snying nas dbang med drangs/ /ngur mo'i sgra bcas mdun du 'khod/ /slar yang hūm̐ las 'phros pa yi/ /rdo rje rgya gram re re ni/ /sde brgyad so so'i spyi bor bzhag /'gul 'khyogs spangs te gnas par bsam/ che ba'i nga rgyal 'di ltar bskyed/ hūm̐/ nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab/

/nga ni gshin rje kun gyi yum/ /nga ni khams gsum kun gyi bdag /nga ni dbang phyug chen po ste/ /nga ni srog gcod kun gyi rje/ /nga ni srid pa kun gyi bdag /nga ni skye 'gro kun gyi yab/ /nga ni snying khrag kun gyi bdag /khyod kyi snying khrag nga la yod/ /nga yi las rnams khyod kyis bsgrubs/ ces lta ba gyad kyi gdeng bskyed la/ lce dbus hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /sde brgyad rnams kyi snying ga nas/ /srog yig bkugs pas thal sbyar 'dar/ /'dud cing ji gsung bka' nod cing*/ /srog snying tshur drangs hūm̐ gi gdan/ /nyi ma'i dal la thim par bsam/ /zil gnon 'khor 'das kun bdag nga'o/ zhes che ba'i nga rgyal bcas/ /oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan/ /sa ga pā sha nan/ nā ga du du nan/ ma maṃ ma maṃ/ tsir tsar tsir tsar/ baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu/ rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya/ ho ra ho ra/ tsi du sod tsi du sod shig lhū ru gtubs/ ha la pa ti nan/ 'khor ba thul/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kā bā tsi brlag brlag brlag sngags grangs bdun cu don gcig yod/ /zhes rtsa sngags ci nus su bzla'o/ /de yang gu ru pad+ma'i zhal nas/ /rab ni zhag bdun dag na 'grub/ /'bring ni bcu bzhi dag na 'grub/ /tha ma nyi shu rtsa gcig yin/ /nus pa bya'am khy-i la tshad/ /ling gis song na 'grub pa yin/ /brgyal lam shi na thal ba yin/ /'di lta bu yi sngags rgod kyis/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyang 'phrog par nus/ /dpag bsam shing yang gcod par nus/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'chi bar nus/ /mi dang 'byung po smos ci dgos/ zhes dang*/ thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i sngags rgod 'di/ /sgrub tu med par thog bab nus pa che ste sngags rgod yin/ /sde brgyad dbang du sdud pa kun gyi gcun phur yin/ /gzhan gy-i nus pa 'jig pa gdug pa dpal gsod yin/ /thams cad brlag par byed pa gsod pa'i drag sngags yin/ /mdze nad sel bar byed pa dug sel nag po yin/

/gang dmigs brlag par byed pa rno ngar mtshon cha yin/ /'byung po brlag par byed pa bram ze lok+t+ri yin/ /ces kyang bzlog tu med pa drang srong dmod pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de nas drag sngags ring mo bzla ba ni/ /rdo rje'i rtse yi phaṭa rnams las/ /gnam lcags rdo rje me 'bar ba/ /mgar gyi tshwa tshwa ltar 'phros nas/ /bka' las 'khu zhing dam log pa'i/ /gnod byed rnams la phog pa yis/ /rtswa sbur me yis bsreg pa ltar/ /tshag sgra dang bcas skad cig gis/ /rjes shul tsam yang med par gyur/ /ces bsam la/ /hūm̐/ sangs rgyas thams cad gzu dang dpang*/ /dam chos rin chen gzu dang dpang*/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa gzu dang dpang*/ /dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang*/ /chos skyong srung ma gzu dang dpang*/ /rgyal 'gong chen po 'dul ba'i phyir/ /drang srong chen po dri med ni/ /sku ni mi 'gyur brtan pa la/ /phyag mtshan 'khor lo bsgyur bzhin du/ /dgra bgegs mgo la 'khor lo bskor/ /rgyal 'gong mgo la 'khor lo bskor/ /sde brgyad srog la 'khor lo bskor/ /'khor lo g.yas su bskor tsa na/ /rgyal 'gong snying la 'khor lo rgyob/ /'khor lo g.yon du bskor tsa na/ /mo gdon snying la 'khor lo rgyob/ /ces byas la/ oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan rbad thums/ 'jig rten mgon po'i srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ sa ga pā sha nan rbad ling*/ sa bdag gi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ nā ga du du nan rbad phaṭa/ klu bdud kyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ ma maṃ ma maṃ rbad myogs/ /ma mo'i srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yau rbad/ tsir tsar tsir tsar rbad rbud/ btsan gyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yau rbad/ baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu rbad thuṃ/ bdud kyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/

rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha la rbad khos/ gza' bdud kyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ ho ra ho ra rbad shag /rgyal 'gong gi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ rgyal po'i srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ bsen mo'i srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ be har gyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ /gtsang thel gyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ gnod byed kyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ che ge mo'i gnod byed bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rgyal 'gong gi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ yang na pha rol byad mas rbad pa'i rgyal 'gong gi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ /a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sde brgyad kyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ tsi du sod tsi du sod rbad thims/ shig lhu ru gtubs rbad myogs/ ha la pa ti nan/ ga na pa ti rbad rmugs/ 'khor ba thul rbad choms/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kā ba tsi brlag brlag rbad hur/ dgra bgegs che ge mo'i dgra bgegs byad ma dam sri rgyal 'gong thams cad srog la mā ra ya rbad rbad/ gnod byed rgyal po thams cad ra tsa hab le hab le sod/ klu thams cad nā ga ling nā ga ling sod/ 'byung po thams cad ka hri ku hri sod/ bgegs thams cad 'gug ge 'gug ge sod/ gza' thams cad the tse the tse sod/ the'u rang thams cad ra tri ra tri mā ra ya sod/ /bsen mo thams cad ro tri ro tri mā ra ya sod/ gre bo gre mo thams cad suṃ tri sum tri mā ra ya sod/ gnod byed dgra bgegs che ge mo gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma dam sri rgyal 'gong thams cad mā ra ya sod sod rbad rbad dzaḥdzaḥ thun sngags 'di ni sngags ring mo zhes bya ba/ ting 'dzin med kyang bzlas pa tsam gyis gcod pa yin zhing*/ lta gdengs dang bcas zhe sdang gi nyams hur phyungs la bzlas par bya ste/

ji skad du/ drag sngags ring mo 'dzin la rno/ zhe sdang ma yal mthu yi mchog /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /sngags ci rigs bzlas mthar thal rdeb ni/ mtha' ma'i phyag gnyis rdo rje brag ri ltar/ /sra mkhregs phyag mthil nyi zla'i kha bar du/ /dgra bgegs sdig can thal bar 'thag pa yi/ /sha khrag sor mo sdig pa mgo dgu pa/ /rnams kyis lhag ma med par zos par gyur/ /zhes dmigs pa gsal btab la drang srong gi dmaud pa 'di brjod cing thal mo brdab par bya'o/ /bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /srid pa spyi nas shig cig /srid gsum rmangs nas sgyel cig /'khor ba gting nas phyungs shig /bskal pa'i mes sregs shig /dam tshig gi dmod pas sdigs shig /bka' yi chad pas chod cig /gnam lcags ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig /sum+bha nis non cig /srid gsum gar skyes gar gnas kyang sdig can 'di'i steng du gnam lcags rdo rje me yi char chen po phobs shig /gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad thul cig /zhes dang mthar/ /bka' bsgo 'di yi nus pa yis/ /thal phye rlung gis gtor ba ltar/ /gnod byed de ru gnas mi 'gyur/ /gal te gnas na brlag par byed/ /drang srong dmod de bzlog tu nan/ /zhes dang*/ nam mkha' med par gyur na yang*/ /sngags kyi dngos grub med mi srid/ /lha dang drang srong gis bshad pa'i/ /rig sngags bslu ba mi srid na/ /'dod chags bral bas bshad pa yi/ /gsang sngags sbyor bas bslu ba ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod nas yid ches kyi nges shes bskyed do/ /mthar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas snod bcud 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang du bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas 'od gsal gyi ngang nas drang srong zhi ba'am khro bo'i skur ldangs la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis dge ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod/

nyal na chu la langs na me/ 'dug na thag la 'gro na rlung*/ zhes pa'i don bzhin rgyun gyi spyod lam bskyang ngo*/ /yang srung ba'i skabs kyi dmigs 'don ni/ /hūm̐/ thugs srog hūm̐ yig 'bar ba yi/ /thig ler bla ma slob dpon dang*/ /khog par rang dang mtha' skor du/ /bsrung bya dbus su rang nyid drang srong zhi ba'i rnams pa/ g.yas su bsrung bya pho/ g.yon du mo/ rgyab du khang zhing*/ mdun du nor rdzas thams cad dmigs/ mtha' dag tshud par gyur/ /smra byed rdo rje'i yig 'bru las/ /'od zer pho nya'i tshogs spros pas/ /rang dang bsrung bya thams cad kyi/ /tshe srog brkus phrog yar 'khyams dang*/ /snod bcud yon tan ma lus pa/ /tshur bsdus bsrung bya thams cad la/ /bstims pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar/ /nang du rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang sems ma lus til gang bzhin/ /nam mkha'i phyogs kun khyab pa yis/ /bsrung skyobs byin gyis brlab par mdzad/ /phyi rol phyag mtshan lnga dang ni/ /rlung me chu sa khro chung gur/ /nang bltas 'jam zhing srubs med la/ /phyi bstas rno dbal gcod ngar ldan/ /drag sngags dmod tshig rang sgra bcas/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i gur gyis gtam/ /cis kyang mi shigs par ru gyur/ /oṃ lok+ṭi pā la nan srungs sogs/ ho ra ho ra srungs/ tsi du sod tsi du sod shig lhu ru gtums ha la pa ti nan 'khor ba thul/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kā bā tsi brlag brlag nṛ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor bcas la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes bzla'o/ /bzlog par byed na/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yi/ /smra byed rdo rje rtse dgu rtser/ /phaṭa dmar me yi tshwa tshwa ni/ /rno ngar shugs drag 'phro ba dang*/ /mtha' phyag gnam lcags lag pa'i mthil/ /sor mo sdig pa gdengs pa'i dbus/ /byad ma lhar bcas gsal ba 'thag /gtso bo bdag dang gur khang gi

/lha tshogs thams cad phyir gzigs nas/ /drag sngags dmod pa cher bsgrags pas/ /sku yi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /sprul pa'i pho nya nad mtshon can/ /nam mkha' gang bar spros pa yis/ /byad ma skyob byed lha srung rnams/ /kho rang gshed phab srung 'khor bshig /me lces slebs pa'i sbrang bu bzhin/ /bcom bsreg thal ba nyid byas nas/ /drag po'i rlung gis bskyod pa yi/ /shing bal bzhin du mthar bskrad gyur/ /oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan bh+yo bzlog nas/ ho ra ho ra bh+yo bzlog tsi du sod nas/ brlag brlag /dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya bh+yo bzlog /ces bzla zhing mthar bden brjod dang drang srong dmod pa bcas thal rdeb bya'o/ /bsad pa la/ dang por 'gug pa ni/ rang lus gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /mdun du e yig las byung ba'i/ /brubs khung lcags khang gru gsum pa/ /dug gi mun 'khrigs bskal me 'bar/ /nad kyi na bun mtshon char 'bebs/ /de yi nang du gshin rje ni/ /pho mo 'jigs rung gnyis kyi bar/ /nṛ tri yongs gyur dmigs bya ni/ /mgon med skyabs bral nyams thag pa/ /mtha' skor dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs/ /'jigs gzugs mtshon cha thogs pas bskor/ /smra byed rdo rje'i rtse mo nas/ /'od zer dzaḥyig pho nyar 'phros/ /dmigs bya dbang med nyid bzung nas/ /mdun gyi rten la thim par gyur/

bden brjod mthar/ oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan dzaḥ nas/ ho ra ho ra nan dzaḥ tsi du sod nas/ thul bar dang*/ yi dam lha dang drang srong gi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis myur du phob cig nṛ tri dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ces ci rigs bzlas pas bkug la/ bsad pa dngos ni/ rdo rje'i rtse yi phaṭa rnams las/ /gnam lcags rdo rje me 'bar ba/ /mgar gyi tshwa tshwa ltar 'phros pa/ /gnod byed rnams la phog pa yis/ /bya sgro me yis bsreg pa ltar/ /nag rog song nas lha dang phral/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad bshig /snying ga nṛ tri'i dbus su ni/ /phaṭa yig dmar nag zhu ba las/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /lcags sred lta bu rnau dbal can/ /rtsibs drug g.yon du 'khor ba yis/ /sha khrag ma lus myal myal gtubs/ /sde brgyad tshogs kyis rjes med du/ /hab sgra dir dir zos par gyur/ /ces brjod cing dmigs la gong gi thun sngags sam/ /thun sngags la dgra bgegs bsad pa'i them sbyar ba'am/ yang na/ oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan sod nas/ ho ra ho ra sod/ tsi du sod tsi du sod nas/ brlag brlag /dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya rbad rbad sod sod ces sam/ gnod byed dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya sod sod ces sam/ dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya sod/ nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad ya: zhes bzla'o/ /'di rnams ni ting nge 'dzin kho nas sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bcas chog dang 'brel ba'i 'don sgom gyi tshul rgyas pa ni sngon gyi rig 'dzin rnams kyi gsung las shes par bya'o/ /'di ni rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung sor bzhag khrigs su bsdeb nas man ngag gi gsal por bstan pa ste/ bklag pas grub pa'i drag sngags ches zab cing rno ba yin pas shin tu gsang bar bya'o/ /thun mtshams su drang srong la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ rin po che'i snod du nas 'bras so ba sogs kyi zan gtsang ma'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum shing thog gis bskor ba chu gtsang bcas bshams/

swā bha ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod/ /nam mkha' lta bur rab yangs dbus/ /bh+rūm̐ las lha rdzas gtor ma ni/ /kha dog dri ro reg bya ldan/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i/ /gnas gsum yi ges mtshan pa yi/ /oṃ las 'od 'phros 'bag rtsog sbyang*/ /āḥyis nam mkha' mnyam par spel/ /hūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor zhu/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las/ /'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas/ /rgya gar lho phyogs in+d+ra'i yul/ /ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo na/ /nags tshal drwa ba can dbus nas/ /drang srong dri med 'od zer ni/ /'bum phrag drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /skad cig nyid la spyan drangs te/ /mdun du pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ dang por badz+ra pā ṇi sogs/ yi dam lha la phul byas nas/ de nas drang srong rnams la 'bul/ oṃ trang du tri na trang du dza dza kha kha khā hi khā hi du na ya swā hā/ /drang srong dri med 'od zer la sogs drang srong rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de skad lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /gsol zhing drang srong mnyes nas su/ /ji 'dod smon lam gdab mdzad cing*/ /drang srong dmod pa bzlog par bsam/ / 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ badz+ra mu yis gshegs su gsol/ /grangs bsogs na dkar mngar 'dres pa'i zan ril chu gtsang bcas la grangs bsogs par bya'o/ /'di ni tshogs bsags dang sngags grub pa'i rgyab skyor dang bar chad zhi ba dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i thabs dam pa yin no/ /drang srong tshe sgrub bya ba na/ drang srong zhi ba'i thugs ka ru/ /nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor dbus/ /traṃ dkar tha mar sngags kyis bskor/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /srid zhi'i tshe dpal bsod nams bsdus/ /bdag thim gzi brjid bkrag mdangs rgyas/ /oṃ trang du tri na trang du dza dzaḥ ma ma ā yu tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ zhes bzla'o/ /'di rnams ni rig 'dzin pad+ma'i thugs bcud dam pa grub brnyes gong ma rnams kyi rdo rje'i gsung gi snying po khrigs su bsdeb pa yin la/
tshul 'di ni rab tshes thams cad 'dul ces pa'i khrums zla'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gsum la lhag pa'i lha 'di'i bsnyen mtshams la gnas pa'i tshe mi pham rnam par rgyal bas spel ba dge'o/
